title: scorzoneroides montaniformis
intro: Scorzoneroides montaniformis, commonly known as Mountain Salsify, is a plant species in the genus Scorzoneroides, characterized by its yellow flowers and edible roots. The health benefits of Mountain Salsify include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, aid in digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Salsify include inulin, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
